method: Actual running local process-evidence UI captured by supported CUA, with actual button-triggered isolated API/SQLite checks and real repository excerpts/diff. Real acquisition timestamps retained inside shots. Explicit labeled idle cuts; no interpolation, synthetic motion or speedup.

editing.method: Only >1000ms between-chapter idle acquisition gaps removed; each retains a 200ms bridge and a three-second explicit on-screen cut label. Every genuine source frame retained; no interpolation or speedup.
